answer.reason: Maryland's in-state electricity generation is dominated by independent power producers and combined heat/power plants, with total net generation in the range of tens of millions of megawatthours. The larger figure, 32,450,909 MWh, corresponds to the IPP & CHP category in the EIA state profile, while the smaller figure is not the IPP & CHP total.
